name: dev-loop
description: Pipeline phat trien mot feature: gather -> plan -> act -> verify -> report
whenToUse: Task nhieu buoc, da biet muc tieu, co verifier chay duoc (build/test).
whenNotToUse: Task nho va ro (sua mot ham, them mot field) -> lam thang, dung chay pipeline.

steps.goal: Hieu bai toan va rang buoc that cua repo
steps.delegateWhen: Phai doc tren ~10 file de tra loi mot cau hoi dinh vi
outputs: Quy uoc repo phai bam theo
steps.exitCriteria: Neu duoc lai bai toan bang mot cau, va chi ra duoc file se dung vao

steps.goal: Quyet dinh lam gi va lam sao biet no dung
steps.exitCriteria: MOI buoc co mot lenh verifier chay duoc. Khong co thi ke hoach chua xong.

steps.goal: Viet code trong pham vi da chot
outputs: Phat hien ngoai pham vi (ghi lai, KHONG sua)
steps.verifierCadence: sau MOI don vi nho, khong phai mot lan o cuoi
steps.exitCriteria: Build xanh sau moi don vi

steps.goal: Xac dinh khach quan: xanh hay do
outputs: PASS | FAIL | KHONG KIEM CHUNG DUOC
Phan khong co test bao phu
steps.exitCriteria: PASS. 'KHONG KIEM CHUNG DUOC' KHONG phai PASS.

steps.goal: Bao cao dua tren bang chung cho nguoi doc
steps.exitCriteria: Trang thai duoc neu dung mot trong ba: HOAN THANH | MOT PHAN | BI CHAN

stopConditions.rule: cung tool + cung tham so + cung loi x3
khong duoc ket thuc luot khi build/test do
hanh dong khong hoan tac duoc, hoac het gia thuyet
